cs.t: I have the Microsoft Wireless Comfort Keyboard 5050.  https://www.microsoft.com/accessories/en-ww/products/keyboar...  I love that it's wireless. I love that the mouse has 4 buttons. And the keyboard itself just  feels good  to type on -- the keys have the perfect amount of resistance and mechanical feel without over doing it (in my opinion). I hate that if you break the dongle, there's no way to replace the dongle or re-pair.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's your keyboard and what you love and hate about it?
